meta.name: Tata Rekavo harmonized hotspot record - Peru
meta.unit: VIIRS S-NPP-equivalent vegetation-fire hotspots per month

grid.cell_index: row * cols + col; row = floor((lat-lat0)/deg), col = floor((lon-lon0)/deg)

regions.method: RESOLVE Ecoregions 2017 biome of the hotspot's 0.05-degree cell (sea / lake cells: nearest biome); a biome-month with fewer than 500 clean overlap hotspots of either sensor of the ratio uses the country factor of that month
regions.source: RESOLVE Ecoregions 2017 (Dinerstein et al. 2017, BioScience 67(6):534-545, doi:10.1093/biosci/bix014), CC BY 4.0; biomes (BIOME_NUM) rasterized at 0.05 deg by cell centre, data/ext/biomes_latam.npz

meta.factor_definition: VIIRS S-NPP / MODIS {aqua|terra} hotspots, vegetation fires, clean overlap days 2012-02-01..2025-12-31
sources: NASA FIRMS MODIS Collection 6.1 (Terra, Aqua) standard processing
NASA FIRMS VIIRS 375 m (Suomi NPP, NOAA-20) standard processing

error_model.formula: relative_error(n) = min(1, c * n^(-p)) where n = harmonized hotspots in the zone-month; for months before viirs_start add the systematic term in quadrature: sqrt(rel^2 + sys[year]^2); months from viirs_start are observed (no translation error)
error_model.meaning: median absolute relative error (about half of zone-months fall inside the band)
